sources.role: Accepted species with several accepted infraspecific taxa

sources.citation: Flora of North America vol. 14, Cuscuta obtusiflora var. glandulosa
Flora of North America, genus Cuscuta

taxon_scope_warning: FNA numeric measurements below apply specifically to var. glandulosa, NOT automatically to all plants or all accepted varieties of C. obtusiflora.

var_glandulosa_morphology.calyx: Shallowly cupulate, divided about halfway, with blunt lobes
var_glandulosa_morphology.corolla: Creamy white, 1.6–2.5 mm, spreading lobes with rounded or obtuse ends
var_glandulosa_morphology.infrastaminal_scales: Oblong to obovate, 1–1.5 mm, often fimbriate distally
var_glandulosa_morphology.capsule: Depressed-globose, 1.5–3 × 2.5–4 mm, indehiscent with relatively large interstylar opening; corolla remnants envelop basal capsule

diagnostic_comparison: FNA notes var. glandulosa versus Cuscuta polygonorum: five-merous flowers, blunt corolla lobes, and fimbriate infrastaminal scales; distinguish from C. gronovii var. latiflora by depressed capsules not thickened around the interstylar opening.
existing_learner_limitation: Original species.json has only generic yellow-orange threads and clustered flowers; taxon-level identity cannot be confirmed from host threads or flower color alone.
